title: Witches Before the Celestial Wheel
description: Two witches in flowing robes stand on a stone terrace, one holding a glowing staff. They face a massive circular stained-glass window resembling a sunburst wheel with intricate geometric patterns and runic symbols along its dark outer rim.
prompt: Two witches wearing long flowing robes and pointed hats stand on a cobblestone terrace with potted ferns and orange flowers. One holds a glowing staff. They are looking at an enormous circular stained glass window that dominates the scene, featuring a bright sunburst center with radiating geometric panels in blue, green, yellow and orange, surrounded by a black rim with glowing runes. Behind the window are misty mountains under a bright sky, in a colorful fantasy illustration style.
